description: Push a FLOW-ORDERED code review to Anti-Vibe: the human walks the change in runtime execution order (like a sequence diagram), not file-by-file. Send ONLY the traversal STRUCTURE — never the diff text. Anti-Vibe resolves each hunk by running `git diff` in the repo and matching your locators. Order `flow` stops top→bottom in call order (entry → handler → service → effect); put models/schemas/contracts/types in `foundation` and list them bottom→up. Each stop maps to a FILE — the reviewer steps through all of that file's hunks one at a time. `locator` is an OPTIONAL hint (exact `hunkHeader` "@@ -a,b +c,d @@ ..." or `lineRange`) that just sets the match-confidence badge. Give each stop a one-line summary. For unchanged connective steps (a dispatcher/existing handler the flow passes through), add a stop with `context: true` and no locator so the sequence reads continuously. When a stop's file has several hunks, add `hunkFlow` to order them for reading in execution order (behavior change before plumbing) with a one-line note per hunk.

diffBase.description: git diff base, e.g. "HEAD~1" or "main...HEAD" (default: working tree).

repoPath.description: Repo to run git diff in (defaults to ANTIVIBE_REPO_DIR or cwd).

callsTo.description: Stops this stop calls into: bare ids, or { to, via } to label the edge with the calling function.

via.description: Caller-side function the call happens in, e.g. "handleSubmit" — shown as the edge label.

context.description: True for a connective step with NO change, shown so the flow reads continuously (no diff resolved).

explanation.description: Markdown prose explaining the change at this stop.

file.description: Path of the changed file (repo-relative). The stop resolves to all of this file's hunks.

hunkFlow.description: SEMANTIC reading order for the stop's hunks (execution order, not source order), each with a caption. Hunks not listed append after in source order. Omit to read hunks in source order.

match.description: Locator for the hunk this reading step refers to (one of hunkHeader / lineRange).

lineRange.description: New-file line range of the hunk.

note.description: One-line "why read this next" caption shown above the hunk.

id.description: Unique id for this stop; referenced by other stops' callsTo.

locator.description: Optional hint marking the primary hunk / match confidence. All file hunks are shown regardless.

hunkHeader.description: The `@@ ... @@` header of the primary hunk (optional hint).

lineRange.description: New-file line range of the primary hunk (optional hint).

oneLineSummary.description: One-line gist of the hunk in view.

name: review_flow
title: Send a flow-ordered code review to Anti-Vibe
